commit_rhythm.en: Do not squash the failing run away. That red mark is the evidence.
commit_rhythm.zh: 不要把失败那次 squash 掉，那个红叉就是证据。

goal.en: Add CI to a repo you already own, then deliberately push a breaking change to prove the pipeline stops it.
goal.zh: 给你自己的仓库加上 CI，然后故意推一个会坏的改动，证明流水线能拦住它。

interview_questions.en: What has your CI actually caught?
interview_questions.zh: 你的 CI 真的拦住过什么？

interview_questions.en: What does your pipeline not check, and does that worry you?
interview_questions.zh: 你的流水线没检查什么？这件事让你担心吗？

interview_questions.en: How long does it take, and what would you cut first?
interview_questions.zh: 它跑多久？你会先砍掉哪一步？

deliverable.en: .github/workflows/ci.yml running tests.
deliverable.zh: 一个跑测试的 .github/workflows/ci.yml。

focus.en: Run your test suite on every push.
focus.zh: 每次 push 都跑测试套件。

deliverable.en: A red run and its fix, both in the public history.
deliverable.zh: 公开历史里一次红色运行和它的修复。

focus.en: Push a commit that fails on purpose; let it go red, then fix it in the next commit.
focus.zh: 推一个故意失败的 commit，让它红掉，再用下一个 commit 修好。

deliverable.en: Checks that fail honestly rather than being set to zero.
deliverable.zh: 会诚实失败的检查，而不是把阈值设成零。

focus.en: Add linting and a coverage threshold that your current code actually passes.
focus.zh: 加上 lint 和一个你当前代码确实能过的覆盖率阈值。

deliverable.en: A README line: 4m12s to 1m05s, with the commit that did it.
deliverable.zh: README 上一行：4m12s 降到 1m05s，附上做到这件事的 commit。

focus.en: Cache dependencies and cut the run time; record the before and after durations.
focus.zh: 缓存依赖，缩短运行时间；记录前后耗时。

scope_guard.en: One workflow file. No matrix across five OSes before the single case works.
scope_guard.zh: 一个 workflow 文件。单一情况跑通之前，不要搞五种系统的矩阵。

title.en: A pipeline that has actually caught something
title.zh: 一条真的拦住过东西的流水线

why_it_proves.en: A green badge proves nothing. A red run in your history, followed by the fix, proves the pipeline is real.
why_it_proves.zh: 一个绿色徽章说明不了什么。历史里一次红色运行加上后面的修复，才证明这条流水线是真的。

commit_rhythm.en: Commit at the end of every working session, even when it is broken — a note in the message saying what is broken is worth more than a tidy history.
commit_rhythm.zh: 每次坐下来写完就提交，哪怕是坏的——在 commit message 里写清楚坏在哪，比一部整齐的历史更有说服力。

goal.en: A producer, a consumer group and a replay tool over one topic, with at-least-once delivery you can demonstrate.
goal.zh: 一个生产者、一个消费者组、一个重放工具，跑在同一个 topic 上，能当场演示至少一次投递。

interview_questions.en: What happens to in-flight messages when a consumer dies before committing its offset?
interview_questions.zh: 消费者在提交 offset 之前挂掉，正在处理的消息会怎样？

interview_questions.en: Your consumer got the same order twice. Walk me through how you made that harmless.
interview_questions.zh: 你的消费者收到了同一笔订单两次，讲讲你是怎么让它不出事的。

interview_questions.en: Why a consumer group instead of one consumer? What breaks when you add a partition?
interview_questions.zh: 为什么用消费者组而不是单个消费者？加一个 partition 会坏掉什么？

deliverable.en: docker-compose.yml + a producer and consumer that print messages.
deliverable.zh: docker-compose.yml，加一个能打印消息的生产者和消费者。

focus.en: Run Kafka in docker-compose; produce and consume JSON order events; commit the compose file first.
focus.zh: 用 docker-compose 起 Kafka；生产和消费 JSON 订单事件；先把 compose 文件提交上去。

deliverable.en: A FAILURE_NOTES.md recording exactly which messages were redelivered.
deliverable.zh: 一份 FAILURE_NOTES.md，写清楚哪些消息被重投了。

focus.en: Switch to manual offset commits. Kill the consumer mid-batch on purpose and write down what you observe.
focus.zh: 改成手动提交 offset。故意在批处理中途 kill 掉消费者，把观察到的现象记下来。

deliverable.en: An idempotent consumer plus a test that replays the same message twice.
deliverable.zh: 一个幂等消费者，外加一个把同一条消息重放两次的测试。

focus.en: Make the consumer idempotent with a processed-ids table, so redelivery stops causing double writes.
focus.zh: 用 processed-ids 表让消费者幂等，重投不再造成重复写入。

deliverable.en: `replay --since` command and a README with one honest paragraph on guarantees.
deliverable.zh: `replay --since` 命令，以及 README 里关于投递保证的一段实话。

focus.en: Add a replay CLI that re-reads from a timestamp; write a README explaining the delivery guarantee you actually have.
focus.zh: 加一个按时间戳重放的 CLI；写 README 说明你实际拿到的是什么投递保证。

scope_guard.en: Do not build a UI. Do not add a second service. One topic, one consumer group, one failure mode handled well.
scope_guard.zh: 不要做界面，不要加第二个服务。一个 topic、一个消费者组、把一种故障处理透。

title.zh: 可重放的订单事件管道

why_it_proves.en: Anyone can run a Kafka tutorial. Handling a consumer crash mid-batch, duplicate delivery and offset replay is what separates 'used Kafka' from 'understands Kafka'.
why_it_proves.zh: 跑通教程谁都会。消费者在批处理中途挂掉、重复投递、offset 重放——能讲清楚这三件事，才是『懂 Kafka』而不是『用过 Kafka』。

commit_rhythm.en: One commit per manifest change, with the kubectl output that motivated it pasted into the message.
commit_rhythm.zh: 每改一次 manifest 就提交一次，把促使你改的那段 kubectl 输出贴进 commit message。

goal.en: Take a service you already wrote, run it on kind/minikube with health checks, resource limits and a rolling update.
goal.zh: 拿一个你已经写过的服务，跑在 kind/minikube 上，配上健康检查、资源限制和滚动更新。

interview_questions.en: What is the difference between liveness and readiness, and what happens if you get them backwards?
interview_questions.zh: liveness 和 readiness 有什么区别？如果配反了会发生什么？

interview_questions.en: Your pod is CrashLoopBackOff. What are the first three commands you run?
interview_questions.zh: 你的 pod 进了 CrashLoopBackOff，你敲的前三条命令是什么？

interview_questions.en: Why did your rolling update stall, and what would have happened in production?
interview_questions.zh: 你那次滚动更新为什么卡住了？如果发生在生产会怎样？

deliverable.en: Dockerfile + deployment.yaml, pod reaching Running.
deliverable.zh: Dockerfile 和 deployment.yaml，pod 能进入 Running。

focus.en: Containerise your existing service and get it running in kind with a plain Deployment.
focus.zh: 把你已有的服务容器化，用一个最朴素的 Deployment 跑在 kind 上。

deliverable.en: A NOTES.md with the real `kubectl describe` output of your OOMKill.
deliverable.zh: NOTES.md 里贴上你那次 OOMKill 的真实 `kubectl describe` 输出。

focus.en: Add liveness/readiness probes and memory limits. Lower the limit until it gets OOMKilled, then record the event.
focus.zh: 加上存活/就绪探针和内存限制。把限制调低直到被 OOMKilled，把事件记下来。

deliverable.en: A recorded rollout stall and `kubectl rollout undo`.
deliverable.zh: 一次被记录下来的发布卡死，以及 `kubectl rollout undo`。

focus.en: Do a rolling update that breaks readiness on purpose and watch the rollout stall; then fix and roll back.
focus.zh: 做一次故意让就绪探针失败的滚动更新，看着发布卡住；然后修好并回滚。

deliverable.en: Config split out of the image, plus an honest 'not production ready because…' section.
deliverable.zh: 配置从镜像里拆出来，外加一段诚实的『还不能上生产，因为……』。

focus.en: Add a ConfigMap and a Secret, and write a README on what you would still need before this is production-safe.
focus.zh: 加上 ConfigMap 和 Secret，并在 README 写清楚：要上生产还缺什么。

scope_guard.en: No service mesh, no operator, no cloud account. One deployment, one service, one ingress at most.
scope_guard.zh: 不要 service mesh，不要 operator，不要云账号。最多一个 deployment、一个 service、一个 ingress。

title.en: Deploy your own service to a local cluster, then break it on purpose
title.zh: 把你自己的服务部署到本地集群，然后故意弄坏它

why_it_proves.en: Using someone else's Helm chart proves nothing. Debugging your own CrashLoopBackOff and OOMKill proves you have been there.
why_it_proves.zh: 套别人的 Helm chart 说明不了什么。自己调通一次 CrashLoopBackOff 和 OOMKill，才说明你真待过。

commit_rhythm.en: Commit the instrumentation separately from the fix, so the history shows you measured before you touched anything.
commit_rhythm.zh: 把埋点和修复分开提交，让历史显示你是先量后动手。

goal.en: Instrument a service you already wrote so you can see where a slow request spends its time.
goal.zh: 给你已经写过的服务加上埋点，让你看得见一个慢请求的时间花在哪。

interview_questions.en: Where did the time actually go in your slow request?
interview_questions.zh: 你那个慢请求的时间到底花在哪了？

interview_questions.en: What is the overhead of your instrumentation?
interview_questions.zh: 你的埋点带来多大开销？

interview_questions.en: What would you alert on, and what would you deliberately not alert on?
interview_questions.zh: 你会对什么告警？又刻意不对什么告警？

deliverable.en: A docker-compose with the collector and your first trace.
deliverable.zh: 一个带 collector 的 docker-compose 和你的第一条 trace。

focus.en: Run a local collector and export traces from one endpoint.
focus.zh: 起一个本地 collector，把一个接口的 trace 导出去。

deliverable.en: A screenshot-free note naming the slowest span and its duration.
deliverable.zh: 一条不靠截图的记录，写明最慢的 span 和它的耗时。

focus.en: Add spans around your database and HTTP calls; find the slowest span.
focus.zh: 在数据库和 HTTP 调用外面加 span，找出最慢的那一段。

deliverable.en: Before/after span durations in the README.
deliverable.zh: README 里前后两次的 span 耗时。

focus.en: Fix or reduce that span; capture the trace again and compare.
focus.zh: 修掉或缩短那一段；重新抓一次 trace 做对比。

deliverable.en: An alert rule with a sentence on why that threshold.
deliverable.zh: 一条告警规则，外加一句话说明为什么是这个阈值。

focus.en: Add one metric and one alert rule you would genuinely want paged on.
focus.zh: 加一个指标和一条你真的愿意被半夜叫醒的告警规则。

scope_guard.en: One service, one trace, a local collector. No dashboards you will never look at.
scope_guard.zh: 一个服务、一条链路、一个本地 collector。不要做你根本不会去看的大盘。

title.en: Trace one real request end to end
title.zh: 把一个真实请求从头到尾追一遍

why_it_proves.en: 'Added logging' is noise. A trace that located a real bottleneck is a story with a number in it.
why_it_proves.zh: 『加了日志』是噪音。一条定位到真实瓶颈的 trace，是一个带数字的故事。

commit_rhythm.en: Commit the plan files, not screenshots. Text diffs of query plans are unusually convincing.
commit_rhythm.zh: 提交计划文本文件，不要截图。查询计划的文本 diff 格外有说服力。

goal.en: Load a realistic dataset, find a genuinely slow query, and fix it with an index or a rewrite you can explain.
goal.zh: 灌入一份有规模的真实数据，找出一个真的慢的查询，用索引或改写把它修好，并且能讲清楚原因。

interview_questions.en: Walk me through your EXPLAIN output. Which node was the problem?
interview_questions.zh: 带我过一遍你的 EXPLAIN 输出，问题出在哪个节点？

interview_questions.en: Why did the planner not use the index at first?
interview_questions.zh: 一开始优化器为什么没用上索引？

interview_questions.en: What did that index cost you on writes?
interview_questions.zh: 这个索引在写入上让你付出了什么代价？

deliverable.en: A seed script that anyone can re-run.
deliverable.zh: 一个别人也能重跑的数据生成脚本。

focus.en: Generate a few million rows of plausible data and commit the generator.
focus.zh: 造几百万行像样的数据，把生成脚本提交上去。

deliverable.en: plans/before.txt committed as-is.
deliverable.zh: 原样提交的 plans/before.txt。

focus.en: Find a query that takes seconds; save its EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) output into the repo.
focus.zh: 找一个要跑几秒的查询，把它的 EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) 存进仓库。

deliverable.en: A commit whose message names the seq scan it removed.
deliverable.zh: 一次 commit，message 里点名它干掉的那个 seq scan。

focus.en: Fix it — index, rewrite or both — and commit plans/after.txt alongside.
focus.zh: 修好它——加索引、改写，或者两者都来——并同时提交 plans/after.txt。

deliverable.en: A short trade-off section in the README.
deliverable.zh: README 里一小节写清楚权衡。

focus.en: Show the index's cost: measure write throughput with and without it.
focus.zh: 展示这个索引的代价：测量加与不加时的写入吞吐。

scope_guard.en: One schema, one slow query, one fix. Resist adding an ORM migration framework.
scope_guard.zh: 一个 schema、一个慢查询、一个修复。忍住别去加 ORM 迁移框架。

title.en: Make one slow query fast, with the plan to prove it
title.zh: 把一个慢查询调快，并且拿执行计划证明

why_it_proves.en: 'Familiar with SQL' is on every resume. An EXPLAIN ANALYZE before and after is not.
why_it_proves.zh: 『熟悉 SQL』每份简历上都有，一前一后两张 EXPLAIN ANALYZE 没有。

commit_rhythm.en: One commit per state you handle — the history then reads as a list of things you thought about.
commit_rhythm.zh: 每处理一种状态就提交一次——这样历史读起来就是一份『你想到了这些』的清单。

goal.en: Build a single real screen against a public API, and handle the four states juniors usually skip.
goal.zh: 对着一个公开 API 做一个真实页面，把初级开发常常跳过的四种状态都处理掉。

interview_questions.en: Show me what your screen does on a 3G connection.
interview_questions.zh: 给我看看你的页面在 3G 下是什么样。

interview_questions.en: Where does your data fetching live, and why there?
interview_questions.zh: 你的数据请求放在哪一层？为什么放那儿？

interview_questions.en: What did you measure before optimising?
interview_questions.zh: 优化之前你量了什么？

deliverable.en: A screen that renders live data.
deliverable.zh: 一个能渲染实时数据的页面。

focus.en: Render real data from a public API, nothing else.
focus.zh: 先把公开 API 的真实数据渲染出来，别的都先不做。

deliverable.en: Four states, each reachable in a demo.
deliverable.zh: 四种状态，每一种都能在演示中触发。

focus.en: Add loading, empty and error states; throttle the network in devtools and fix what breaks.
focus.zh: 加上加载中、空、错误三种状态；在 devtools 里限速网络，把暴露出来的问题修掉。

deliverable.en: A test that fails if the error path regresses.
deliverable.zh: 一个在错误路径回退时会失败的测试。

focus.en: Add a test for the error state and one accessibility fix you can justify (focus, labels, contrast).
focus.zh: 为错误状态加一个测试，再做一处你讲得出道理的无障碍修复（焦点、标签、对比度）。

deliverable.en: Before/after profiler numbers in the README.
deliverable.zh: README 里 profiler 的前后数字。

focus.en: Measure and reduce one real render cost; write what you measured, not what you assume.
focus.zh: 测量并降低一处真实的渲染开销；写你量到的，而不是你猜的。

scope_guard.en: One screen. No design system, no state-management library until you can name the problem it solves.
scope_guard.zh: 只做一个页面。在你能说清它解决什么问题之前，不要引入设计体系和状态管理库。

title.en: One screen that handles loading, empty, error and slow network
title.zh: 一个把加载、空、错误、慢网络都处理好的页面

why_it_proves.en: Everyone's portfolio has a todo app that only renders the happy path. Yours will not.
why_it_proves.zh: 每个人的作品集里都有一个只画了顺利路径的 todo app，你的不是。

commit_rhythm.en: Commit the benchmark before the cache, so the history itself shows you measured first.
commit_rhythm.zh: 先提交压测脚本再提交缓存，让历史本身证明你是先量后改。

goal.en: Put Redis in front of one real query in a project you already have, and handle the stale-read case explicitly.
goal.zh: 在你已有项目的某个真实查询前面加上 Redis，并且把读到脏数据这件事明确处理掉。

interview_questions.en: How does your cache behave the moment the underlying row changes?
interview_questions.zh: 底层数据刚被改掉的那一瞬间，你的缓存表现是什么？

interview_questions.en: What is your TTL and why that number?
interview_questions.zh: 你的 TTL 是多少？为什么是这个数？

interview_questions.en: Redis goes down at 3am. What does a user see?
interview_questions.zh: Redis 凌晨三点挂了，用户看到的是什么？

deliverable.en: A benchmark script and a recorded baseline latency.
deliverable.zh: 一个压测脚本，和一个记录在案的基线延迟。

focus.en: Measure the uncached query first and record the number.
focus.zh: 先测没有缓存时的查询耗时，把数字记下来。

deliverable.en: Before/after numbers in the README, produced by the same script.
deliverable.zh: README 里写上同一脚本跑出的前后数字。

focus.en: Add read-through caching with a TTL; measure again with the same script.
focus.zh: 加上带 TTL 的 read-through 缓存；用同一个脚本再测一次。

deliverable.en: A failing-then-passing stale-read test in the history.
deliverable.zh: 历史里留下一个先失败后通过的脏读测试。

focus.en: Write a test that updates the row and asserts the cache returns stale data; then fix it with explicit invalidation.
focus.zh: 写一个测试：更新这行数据，断言缓存返回的是脏数据；然后用显式失效修掉它。

deliverable.en: A connection-failure path with a test that kills the client.
deliverable.zh: 一条连接失败路径，外加一个把客户端打死的测试。

focus.en: Handle the Redis-is-down path so the app degrades instead of erroring.
focus.zh: 处理 Redis 挂掉的路径，让应用降级而不是报错。

scope_guard.en: One cached query. Do not cache everything. Do not build a cache library.
scope_guard.zh: 只缓存一个查询。不要什么都缓存，更不要造一个缓存库。

title.en: A cache with a correct invalidation story
title.zh: 一个说得清失效逻辑的缓存

why_it_proves.en: Adding a cache is five lines. Knowing when your cache lies is the actual skill.
why_it_proves.zh: 加缓存只要五行代码。知道缓存什么时候会骗你，才是真本事。

commit_rhythm.en: Small commits, every session, with honest messages. Two weeks of real evenings looks nothing like one generated dump.
commit_rhythm.zh: 每次都小步提交，message 写实话。两周真实的晚上，和一次性生成的代码堆，长得完全不一样。

goal.en: Use {skill} inside a project you already have, on a task that would be harder without it.
goal.zh: 在你已有的项目里用上 {skill}，解决一个没有它会更难办的任务。

interview_questions.en: Why did you reach for {skill} here? What was the alternative?
interview_questions.zh: 你为什么在这里用 {skill}？备选方案是什么？

interview_questions.en: What went wrong the first time, and what did you change?
interview_questions.zh: 第一版出了什么问题？你改了什么？

interview_questions.en: What did {skill} cost you — complexity, latency, operational load?
interview_questions.zh: {skill} 让你付出了什么代价——复杂度、延迟，还是运维负担？

deliverable.en: A running hello-world committed to your repo.
deliverable.zh: 仓库里一个跑得起来的 hello-world。

focus.en: Read the official {skill} docs and get the smallest thing running; commit it even if it is ugly.
focus.zh: 读 {skill} 官方文档，把最小的东西跑起来；哪怕很丑也先提交。

deliverable.en: Both paths working, selectable by a flag.
deliverable.zh: 两条路径都能跑，用一个开关切换。

focus.en: Replace one part of your existing project with {skill}; keep the old path for comparison.
focus.zh: 用 {skill} 替换你现有项目的一部分；保留旧路径用于对比。

deliverable.en: A FAILURE_NOTES.md with real output.
deliverable.zh: 一份带真实输出的 FAILURE_NOTES.md。

focus.en: Break it on purpose and handle the failure; write down what you saw.
focus.zh: 故意把它弄坏并处理故障；把你看到的写下来。

deliverable.en: A README with numbers and a trade-off paragraph.
deliverable.zh: 一份有数字、有权衡段落的 README。

focus.en: Measure the difference and write an honest README: what {skill} bought you, and what it cost.
focus.zh: 测量差异，写一份诚实的 README：{skill} 给你带来了什么，又让你付出了什么。

scope_guard.en: Two weeks, evenings only. If it needs a team, it is the wrong project.
scope_guard.zh: 两周，只用晚上。如果它需要一个团队，那就选错项目了。

title.en: Smallest honest project that uses {skill} for something real
title.zh: 用 {skill} 做一件真事的最小诚实项目

why_it_proves.en: A standalone demo of {skill} looks like every tutorial. {skill} wired into your own code does not.
why_it_proves.zh: 一个孤立的 {skill} demo 跟所有教程长得一样；{skill} 接进你自己的代码里就不一样了。

commit_rhythm.en: Keep generated code out of the history or in a single clearly-named commit, so your own work stays visible.
commit_rhythm.zh: 把生成代码排除在历史之外，或者放进一次明确命名的提交，让你自己写的部分依然看得见。

goal.en: Define a .proto for an endpoint you already have, generate both sides, and compare the two under load.
goal.zh: 为你已有的一个接口写 .proto，生成客户端和服务端，然后在压力下对比两者。

interview_questions.en: Why gRPC here instead of REST? Give me the number that convinced you.
interview_questions.zh: 这里为什么用 gRPC 而不是 REST？给我那个说服了你的数字。

interview_questions.en: What breaks for a browser client, and how would you deal with it?
interview_questions.zh: 浏览器客户端会坏在哪？你打算怎么办？

interview_questions.en: How do you evolve a .proto without breaking old clients?
interview_questions.zh: 怎么演进 .proto 才不会打断老客户端？

deliverable.en: A .proto file and a generated-code build step.
deliverable.zh: 一个 .proto 文件和一个生成代码的构建步骤。

focus.en: Write the .proto and generate stubs; commit the proto before any implementation.
focus.zh: 写 .proto 并生成桩代码；在写实现之前先提交 proto。

deliverable.en: Both paths serving the same data.
deliverable.zh: 两条路径返回同样的数据。

focus.en: Implement the server and a client; keep the REST route alive side by side.
focus.zh: 实现服务端和客户端；让 REST 路由并行保留。

deliverable.en: A benchmark table in the README with the script that produced it.
deliverable.zh: README 里一张压测表格，附上生成它的脚本。

focus.en: Benchmark both with the same payloads; record latency and payload size.
focus.zh: 用相同的 payload 压测两者，记录延迟和报文大小。

deliverable.en: A streaming RPC plus an honest recommendation.
deliverable.zh: 一个流式 RPC，外加一条诚实的结论。

focus.en: Add a streaming RPC and write down which of your two endpoints you would actually ship, and why.
focus.zh: 加一个流式 RPC，并写下你真正会上线的是哪一个、为什么。

scope_guard.en: One service, two or three RPCs. No gateway, no mesh.
scope_guard.zh: 一个服务，两三个 RPC。不要网关，不要 mesh。

title.en: Replace one REST endpoint with gRPC and keep both running
title.zh: 把一个 REST 接口换成 gRPC，并让两者同时在线

why_it_proves.en: The interview question is always 'why not REST?'. You can only answer it if you have run both.
why_it_proves.zh: 面试官永远问『为什么不用 REST？』——只有两种都跑过，你才答得上来。
